summary: Researched the temporal tableau decision procedure (task 301). Confirmed the temporal Formula type (atom/bot/imp/untl/snce, Burgess event-guard, Lukasiewicz-encoded) and that the semantic side (TemporalModel, Satisfies, Valid/ValidSerial/ValidDense/ValidDiscrete) plus a matching FrameClass{Base,Dense,Discrete} (with LE/minFrameClass/Axiom.density) already exist. Identified the correct architecture: instantiate the generic Foundations tableau kernel (Cslib.Logic.Tableau: SignedFormula F L, Branch F L, RuleResult with persistent variant, PropTableauRule/applyPropRule) at F=Temporal.Formula Atom, L=Nat; imitate Modal/Tableau for label-introduction/worklist/Hintikka; PORT the bimodal Decidability algorithms (until/since event-witness vs guard-continue branching, Reynolds co-decomposition, TimeOrdering addFuture/addPast/futureOf/pastOf, density/discreteness rules denseIndicatorClosure/densityRule/priorUZ/priorSZ/z1Rule) which are typed over Bimodal.Formula and cannot be reused directly; follow Propositional Classical for the sorry-free soundness skeleton. Provided an 8-file phased breakdown (Defs/TimeOrdering/Rules/Branch/Closure/Saturation/Soundness/Completeness ~2350 ln), flagged the riskiest obligations (until/since completeness via eventuality fulfilment, termination/blocking soundness, density/discreteness rule soundness, Reynolds co-decomposition termination), and inventoried reusable lemmas. Noted the genuinely new closure mode (eventuality-defect/loop-blocking) has no propositional/modal analogue and that bimodal full FMP-completeness is deferred, so completeness risk must be handled sorry-free or marked BLOCKED (zero-debt).
